title: Find the birth date of the earliest-born female client who holds an account
question: Find the birth date of the earliest-born female client who holds an account in a district where total transaction amounts in 1997 exceeded $10,000, and who is associated with a loan approved before 1998 with duration longer than 24 months.

prediction.sql:
SELECT c."XCL_011"
FROM client AS c
INNER JOIN disp AS d ON c."XCL_009" = d."XCL_014"
INNER JOIN account AS a ON d."XCL_015" = a."XCL_001"
INNER JOIN loan AS l ON a."XCL_001" = l."XCL_034"
WHERE c."XCL_010" = 'F'
  AND l."XCL_035" < '1998-01-01'
  AND l."XCL_037" > 24
  AND a."XCL_002" IN (
    SELECT a2."XCL_002"
    FROM account AS a2
    INNER JOIN trans AS t ON a2."XCL_001" = t."XCL_047"
    WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', t."XCL_048") = '1997'
    GROUP BY a2."XCL_002"
    HAVING SUM(t."XCL_051") > 10000
  )
ORDER BY c."XCL_011" ASC
LIMIT 1;

The loan join is an eligibility condition on the account associated with the client, not a measure; no aggregation over loans is requested.
The district transaction condition is computed at account.XCL_002 grain in a subquery and applied as a semijoin, preventing transaction-row multiplication in the main client selection.
The raw draft's use of loan.XCL_036 > 24 and SUM(trans.XCL_052) is rejected because historical evidence and the question's duration/amount wording support loan.XCL_037 and trans.XCL_051 respectively.

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT c."XCL_011"
FROM client AS c
INNER JOIN disp AS d ON c."XCL_009" = d."XCL_014"
INNER JOIN account AS a ON d."XCL_015" = a."XCL_001"
INNER JOIN loan AS l ON a."XCL_001" = l."XCL_034"
WHERE c."XCL_010" = 'F'
  AND l."XCL_035" < '1998-01-01'
  AND l."XCL_037" > 24
  AND a."XCL_002" IN (
    SELECT a2."XCL_002"
    FROM account AS a2
    INNER JOIN trans AS t ON a2."XCL_001" = t."XCL_047"
    WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', t."XCL_048") = '1997'
    GROUP BY a2."XCL_002"
    HAVING SUM(t."XCL_051") > 10000
  )
ORDER BY c."XCL_011" ASC
LIMIT 1;

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT MIN(c.XCL_011) AS birth_date
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.XCL_009 = d.XCL_014
JOIN account a ON d.XCL_015 = a.XCL_001
JOIN district dist ON a.XCL_002 = dist.XCL_017
JOIN loan l ON a.XCL_001 = l.XCL_034
JOIN trans t ON a.XCL_001 = t.XCL_047
WHERE c.XCL_010 = 'F'
  AND l.XCL_035 < '1998-01-01'
  AND l.XCL_036 > 24
  AND t.XCL_048 BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
GROUP BY dist.XCL_017
HAVING SUM(t.XCL_052) > 10000
